judge.same_model_caveat: RESULTS must state that the pilot judge and the pilot generator are the same model. The user visual verdict remains authoritative.

judgment_rule.qualitative: Astra Max judges first, and the user's visual check is final, only for the qualitative items this rubric lists. Those items are the ones the sources already delegate to that judgment.
judgment_rule.numeric_gates: A visual verdict does not override a required numeric gate or a critical-dimension gate, and it does not waive C-R5v2 preparation preconditions.
judgment_rule.missing_critical_numeric: A missing critical numeric control would be a QUESTION FOR THE USER entry and would freeze-block this draft. Checked against DECISIONS.md: the listed critical values are already answered, so question_for_user is empty. No further number is chosen here.
judgment_rule.retired_catch_all: The previous unspecified marker 'Astra+user visual' is not an operative catch-all. An unlisted fit, clearance, continuity, face, or placement item is not converted into a visual pass.

exit.rule: Passing all 5 of U1-U5 is a mandatory v4 exit criterion. v4 exits only when the existing exit gates pass and all 5 of U1-U5 pass.

operative_roster.rule: U3 and U4 are in the operative roster, subject to implementation, freeze, and the actual preparation and acceptance gates. An unsupported or failing task stays in the denominator. It prevents v4 exit.

common_gates.first_handover: Each of U1-U5 passes on its first handover, needing no edits or fixes of 5 minutes or less, with no critical dimension error and no fabrication. Astra Max judges first; the user's visual check is final.
common_gates.existing_exit_gates: The existing exit gates are also required. This rubric does not replace them with a per-task dimensional list.
common_gates.cycle: One complete U1-U5 roster per manifest. Exit requires 5/5 within the same frozen manifest, one attempt each, with no retake after seeing results. Successes from different cycles are never combined. Old outcomes are kept.
common_gates.deliverable: FreeCAD 1.1.4 single-part model (FCStd + STEP) for every task. For the declared multi-piece C2 case only, C-R6 allows separate solids in that one document and STEP, with no bridges, backing, or joins. Every other task remains one solid.
common_gates.clocks: The five-minute rule above is the C-EXIT first-handover rule. Counts and clocks from the previous template are not criteria.

exit.incomplete: INCOMPLETE is reserved for budget_exhausted or quota_stop. A worker failure keeps that worker status and error code. It is not INCOMPLETE, it is not PASS, and v4 does not exit.

omitted: Counts and clocks from the previous template are not criteria. They are not values in the cited sources. Omitting them does not omit the C-EXIT first-handover rule or the five-minute rule.

preparation.binding: C-R5v2 preconditions bind any U5 preparation that can be scored. The recipe and software identity are dev-frozen and hash-locked before the custodian runs the recipe once. Foreground is the alpha-derived declared foreground in that frozen recipe, not luminance and not require-opaque. The nominal 50 mm height is the final canonical contour Y extent, aspect preserved. Boundary approximation is only what the frozen recipe specifies. Topology stays preserved: holes preserved; no silent deletion, bridging, smoothing, or radius change; no renormalization after scoring. R and tool access are checked on the actual output.
preparation.custodian: The custodian alone prepares U5 once per cycle. Implementers do not see the PNG. There is no tuning on U5. A failure cannot pass that cycle and cannot permit v4 exit. A later cycle needs fresh dev fixes, a new lock and manifest, and fresh blind holdouts for the changed families. Outcomes from different cycles are not combined.
